FILED s532b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-06) from #4168's probes (scratch/s532b/pr/until.pl, p4168loop.pl).  PRE-EXISTING (59317afd the same).  LOW: a loop is rarely the value a caller reads.

    sub u1 { my $i = 5; until ($i > 3) { $i++ } }   # perl 1   PCL ""
    sub u2 { my $i = 0; until ($i > 3) { $i++ } }   # perl 1   PCL ""
    sub w1 { my $i = 0; while ($i) { 1 } }          # perl 0   PCL ""
    sub w2 { my $i = 7; while (!$i) { 1 } }         # perl ""  PCL ""
    lib/LpC.pm = `package LpC; my $i = 5; until ($i > 3) { $i++ }`  -> require: perl 1, PCL dies "did not return a true value"

perl's value of a while/until loop in tail position is the value of the condition's LAST evaluation (the op that ended the loop leaves it on the stack; for `until` the raw condition value, for `while` its false value).  `for`/`foreach` loops answer "" in both (probed: a1..a4 in p4168subloop.pl).  ONE place: the tail lowering of a while/until compound (the sub-body tail machinery #4168 now also uses for a module unit's last segment) -- emit the loop so its value is the last condition value.  Probe the four shapes above + a `last` out of the loop (perl: the value is then whatever `last` leaves -- probe it) before designing.


=== DONE (s537a, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-10 .. 11-13; commits d0e036e1 + the fix-forward d20bd362 on the s537a branch, rebased over MAIN-READY-87; shas as of the rebase over main b620405f) ===
FIXED for loops that end by their TEST: `p-while` / `p-until` / `p-for` / `p-do-while` / `p-do-until` return the condition's last value (`%p-while-loop` / `%p-do-loop` / `%p-loop-test-form` / `%p-loop-value` in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp), so a sub or a required file whose last statement is the loop answers what perl answers: `until` leaves its RAW (true) condition, `while` the false one, an aggregate condition its count.  `p-until COND` is its own head (Parser2 `_lower_while_stmt` + v1 Parser.pm) -- an EMISSION CHANGE at every `until` loop (corpus-diff: loopctl.t state.t).  `foreach` leaves "".  ir-spec §6.2.
FIX-FORWARD (found by this batch's own first combined-tree sweep, t/op/loopctl.t [perl #73618] "constant optimization doesn't change return value"): once the loop's value is the sub's, a variable read only as a loop CONDITION (`my $i = undef; while ($i) { }` as a sub body) showed VarAnnotator's slot verdict -- it froze the bool-only $i to a raw string slot, which reads undef as "".  `_loop_cond_uctx` (Pl/VarAnnotator.pm): the condition of a while / until loop (compound, modifier, `do {} while`) that ENDS its block is a VALUE read, never `bool`.  Guard Pl/t/tail-return-01.t row 13 (perl oracle; main prints "" for undef).
NOT FIXED: a loop left by `last` -> FILED #4801.
GUARD: Pl/t/tail-return-01.t rows 11-12 + Pl/t/require-value-01.t row 7 (inverse-verified on main).  Probes scratch/s537a/p/m2a m2c m2f = perl.
